_about: High and critical advisories that were reviewed and accepted for now. scripts/audit-check.mjs fails on any high or critical advisory that is not listed here, and on a listed one after its reviewBy date. Remove an entry as soon as the advisory is fixed.

accepted.reason: Next.js 14.2 is fixed only in 15.x (a major upgrade, tracked as its own piece of work). Mitigations in place: the image optimizer is switched off (images.unoptimized), no Server Actions, i18n, rewrites or Pages Router are used, production runs on Linux, and a nonce-based CSP is set by our own middleware, which ignores any inbound CSP header.
